rows.text: The congress edition dated Sunday 24 October 1993, under 'Premier premier secrétaire élu par le congrès', reports that at 18:00 on 'samedi' André Laignel gave the result of the first secret-ballot election of the premier secrétaire: 638 registered, 587 voting, 112 blank or void, 'Michel Rocard : 475 voix, soit 80,92% des suffrages'; in an issue dated Sunday 24 October 1993, 'samedi' is 23 October 1993.
